build_protocol_message_class: build a protocol message class at runtime from a Descriptor using GeneratedProtocolMessageType metaclass
serialize_proto_message: serialize a protocol buffer message to a binary string using SerializeToString method
parse_proto_message: parse binary data into a protocol buffer message using MergeFromString method
merge_proto_messages: merge fields from one protocol message into another using the MergeFrom method
check_message_initialization: check if all required fields of a protocol message are set using IsInitialized method
